subject: Simi Valley residents erupt as rotting Boyle Heights warehouse fire food is dumped nearby
posts:
Simi Valley residents rage as millions of pounds of rotting food from a burned warehouse are dumped in their backyard.
Evidence: foul odors, flies, homeowner complaints
#Aletheia #Environment #California

Logistics cleanup operations proceed to dispose of spoiled food from the burned Boyle Heights facility.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Decaying food hauling inflicts noxious odors, pests, and severe quality-of-life strain on an entirely unrelated community.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.8, -0.7) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Corporate disaster management externalizes filth onto unsuspecting residential areas.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 4.5, z: 1)

- Lineage Logistics: FAIL (-0.8, -0.7) — Externalizes waste management burdens onto residents.
- Simi Valley Residents: PASS (+0.8, 0.0) — Rightfully demanding environmental health protections.
Millions of pounds of meat and produce spoiled after a massive June fire at a Lineage Logistics warehouse in Boyle Heights, creating disposal chaos.

The Bright Side:
Bulk removal of the spoiled food has finally been completed, marking progress toward ending the months-long crisis.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis shifts from abstract corporate compliance (WHAT) to concrete physical misery (WHERE) experienced by residents.

Social Physics Analysis:
Shifting toxic waste from a wealthy or industrial center to a residential landfill avoids internal cost at the direct expense of innocent neighbors.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When corporate cleanup expediency overrides community welfare, it plots a trajectory toward Lesser Evil.

Integrity: Partially Distorted

The Unavoidable Truth: Decaying food waste must be disposed of somewhere following a major industrial disaster.

The Unavoidable Lie: Dumping putrid waste next to residential neighborhoods without stringent odor control is acceptable.

Alethekanon:
Corporate logistics failures externalize biohazards onto innocent communities, trading operational convenience for public health misery.

Awwthekanon:
No family should have to endure the suffocating stench of rotting decay and swarming flies right outside their front door.

Brothekanon:
Shipping millions of pounds of rotting meat to a residential landfill is peak dystopian planning. Unreal.

Spirithekanon:
"Do not pollute the land where you are... for blood pollutes the land." Numbers 35:33-34 FAIL
Externalizing toxic waste and foul decay onto innocent communities violates the fundamental stewardship of the earth.
